title: Normalize no-match discovery before aggregating shell results
failure_signature: A parallel repository-discovery batch failed as a whole when one ripgrep query correctly returned exit code one for no matches.
trigger_preconditions: A discovery query where no matches is an acceptable result
candidate_workaround: Run discovery commands independently and normalize ripgrep exit code one to an empty successful result before aggregation.
recurrence_guard: Classify ripgrep exit code one as no-match rather than a tooling fault whenever absence is an allowed discovery outcome.
rollback: Discard the failed aggregate result and rerun only read-only discovery commands; no repository state was changed.
protected_gates: No inference that repository instructions are absent until normalized discovery completes
No task creation or sibling contact
scope_boundary: This method validates discovery control flow only and does not establish repository correctness or any external claim.
